latest.title: Nonuniqueness of Model Potentials and Weak Geodesic Rays
latest.abstract: We establish two nonuniqueness phenomena on $\mathbb{CP}^1$. First, distinct normalized positive-mass model potentials can have the same non-pluripolar Monge--Ampère measure. By the contact-set formula, their zero-contact sets agree $ω_{\mathrm{FS}}$-almost everywhere. Moreover, both have zero Lelong number at every point and identical multiplier ideal sheaves at every positive scale. Second, we construct distinct maximal test curves whose zero-contact sets agree pointwise at every parameter. Their inverse Legendre transforms are distinct bounded weak geodesic rays from zero with the same pointwise right initial tangent.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 在 CP1 上构造不同的正质量模型势却具有相同非多极 Monge–Ampère 测度，并构造不同最大测试曲线对应具有相同初始右切向量的有界弱测地射线。
techniques: Legendre 反变换与弱测地线
latest.breakthrough: 展示测度、接触集、Lelong 数和所有正尺度乘子理想仍不足以唯一确定模型势；相同初始切向量也不决定弱测地射线。
latest.limitations: 反例目前构造于一维复射影空间；高维、附加正则性或能量条件下能否恢复唯一性仍开放。
latest.aiEvidence: 作者使用大型语言模型协助代数核对、部分显式计算和语言编辑，并说明独立检查全部数学论证。
latest.priorityReason: 揭示 Kähler 势理论中多种自然不变量的辨识边界，对奇异测地线与变分问题有直接警示。
